findings.claim: GET/POST /api/v1/accounts/:account_id/conversations/:conversation_id/labels route to index/create. Controller selects @conversation and permits :conversation_id plus labels:[].
create calls update_labels then reads label_list; update_labels assigns update!(label_list:labels), unlike separate add_labels. index reads label_list. Both templates render json.payload @labels.
Normal successful JSON is {payload:[labels]}; POST replaces the assigned list rather than appending. Exact normalization/validation depends on uninspected persistence/tagging internals.

Independently verified B's account/display_id lookup, show? authorization and anonymous/member-agent test descriptions. Existing POST example checks new labels' presence, not replacement or exact payload: one justified unverified contract gap.
